description: Needs the user's AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; each call uses one AI analysis from the licence quota. Turns a short description of what a business wants to buy into a structured scope of work for a tender or request for quotes: subject, work packages with deliverables, exclusions, supplier requirements, service levels, volume assumptions, questions to bidders, award criteria with weights and points to clarify internally. Placeholders where facts are missing; nothing is invented.

details.description: Optional additional facts: places, quantities, dates, budget, special requirements.

language.description: Language of the answer: de, en, fr, es, pt or zh. Default de.

request.description: What is to be bought, in one or two sentences, e.g. 'Office cleaning for 2 sites in Cologne, 5 days a week, from January'.

name: write_scope_of_work
title: Turn one sentence into a scope of work for a request for quotes (AICTIONBOT™ scope writer)
